lines.say: Why do you lift more with music?
Why does this happen, number sixteen.
A big review of almost a hundred and forty studies found music really helps exercise.
It makes hard work feel a little easier, puts you in a better mood, and helps you do more.
Fast songs, around a hundred and twenty to a hundred and forty beats per minute, work best for training.
Music also pulls your attention away from tired signals, so you push a bit longer.
Pick songs you love. Loud is fine, but protect your ears.
Save your best song for your hardest set.
